name: ClientHub
author: NETT.PRO

sections.description:
ClientHub transforms your WordPress site into a powerful client management system and customer portal. With customizable dashboards, project tracking, and secure access control, it’s perfect for freelancers, agencies, and businesses looking to streamline client relationships.

Key Features:

  • Complete client management system with CRM-style contact database
  • Customizable client dashboards with secure login access
  • Project progress tracking with visual indicators and timelines
  • Client-specific messaging system for secure communication
  • Secure file sharing and document management
  • Beautiful, responsive design for mobile and desktop access
  • Role-based permissions for client access control

Whether you’re managing multiple clients or just need a professional way to interact with your customers, ClientHub provides the tools you need to elevate your client relationships and improve project collaboration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clienthub folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘ClientHub’ in your WordPress admin panel to configure the plugin
  4. Add your first client and create projects
  5. Use the shortcode [clienthub] on any page to display the client portal
sections.faq:
Can I customize the look of the client portal?

Yes, ClientHub offers extensive customization options. You can adjust colors, layouts, and branding to match your business identity.

Is ClientHub compatible with my theme?

ClientHub is designed to work with most WordPress themes. The plugin uses WordPress coding standards and follows best practices for compatibility.

How secure is the client data?

We take security seriously. ClientHub uses WordPress’s built-in security features including nonce verification, secure password hashing, and role-based access control to protect sensitive client data.

Can clients access their own portal?

Yes! Each client gets secure login credentials and can access their personalized dashboard to view projects, messages, and shared files.

Do I need coding knowledge to use ClientHub?

No coding required! ClientHub works out of the box with an intuitive interface. Simply install, activate, add clients, and start managing projects.
